c74object.name: void.sm.info
c74object.description:
void.sm.info inspects the header of a POSIX shared memory segment following the VOID Shared Memory contract (version 2) and outputs its metadata as a dictionary.
The object performs a one-shot inspection when it receives a bang. The shared memory segment is opened, validated, read, and immediately closed.
This object does not attach persistently to shared memory and does not participate in the data exchange process. It is intended for debugging, inspection, monitoring, and tooling purposes.
The output dictionary contains topology information, versioning, epoch and frame counters, ownership metadata, and memory layout details.

objarg.name: name
objarg.description:
Name of the POSIX shared memory segment to inspect.
This must match the name used by the corresponding writer.

inlet.description: Accepts a bang message to trigger inspection of the shared memory segment.

outlet.description:
Outputs a dictionary containing information extracted from the shared memory header.
If the shared memory segment is invalid or unavailable, the dictionary reports an invalid state.

attribute.name: name
attribute.description:
Name of the shared memory segment to inspect.
Changing this attribute updates the target inspected on the next bang.

c74object.details:
The output dictionary may contain the following keys when the shared memory segment is valid:
name channels length epoch frame owner_app owner_project owner_node bytes data_offset data_bytes
When validation fails, the dictionary contains at least:
name state = invalid
